swap_risks: CRITICAL SWITCH-VOLTAGE OVERSTRESS RISK: TPS562201DDCR is rated up to only 7 V output (p.1) vs TPS54202DDCR up to 28 V (p.11); exceeding the internal switch BVdss ceiling destroys the SW MOSFET.
HIGH MINIMUM OUTPUT VOLTAGE FLOOR: TPS562201DDCR cannot regulate below 0.76 V (p.1) vs TPS54202DDCR down to 0.596 V (p.5); verify your target rail sits above the higher Vout,min floor.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (TPS54202DDCR: 0.596 V p.5 vs TPS562201DDCR: 0.768 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54202DDCR: 15 µH p.17 vs TPS562201DDCR: 3.3 µH p.13); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (TPS54202DDCR: 28 V p.4 vs TPS562201DDCR: 17 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS562201DDCR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (19 V, p.4) than TPS54202DDCR (30 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 19 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 31% higher on TPS54202DDCR (TPS54202DDCR: 118.6 °C/W p.4 vs TPS562201DDCR: 90.8 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS54202DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) and TPS562201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because adjustable Vout,max ceiling drops >=20% (7 V vs 28 V — switch-voltage overstress risk); minimum programmable Vout,min rises (0.596 V vs 0.76 V); feedback reference voltage Vref differs. Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 500 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.5) (1.2x ratio), typical inductor 15 µH (p.17) vs 3.3 µH (p.13), feedback Vref 0.596 V (p.5) vs 0.768 V (p.5), and package θJA 118.6 vs 90.8 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS54202DDCR "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN" (p.4) and TPS562201DDCR "Pin-Identical 2 A Sibling of TPS563201DDCR — Verify Current Limit & Inductor Sizing" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TPS54202DDCR when bus voltage exceeds 17 V (rated to 28 V) or programmed output rails exceed 7 V (up to 28 V); choose TPS562201DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
